data.title: Future: docket deps path <from> <to> - show dependency path
data.body:
Check if there's a dependency path between two bugs.

```
$ docket deps path pqr6 ghi3

pqr6 → mno5 → abc1 → def2 → ghi3

pqr6 is transitively blocked by ghi3 (4 hops)
```

```
$ docket deps path abc1 stu7

No path: abc1 does not depend on stu7
(Note: stu7 depends on abc1, not the other way)
```

## Future idea

Only implement if users need to diagnose complex dependency chains.
